audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags it directly: Vladimir wins 52.28% but the chart gives Fiora three stages to zero. The mirror audit has already settled row 0 as Fiora and rows 5 and 6 as Vladimir.
audit.why: The two directions must agree, and the corrected shape also matches the win rate — Fiora owns the early duel, Vladimir owns the scaling.
audit.corrected: Row 0 to Fiora, rows 5 and 6 to Vladimir, in matched full/content pairs with ratings, and whys[0], whys[5], whys[6] rewritten so the prose agrees.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Riposte's cooldown' anchored nine instructions with no number, and the ultimate was never priced.
audit.why: Riposte 24/22/20/18/16, Lunge 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6, Grand Challenge 110/90/70, against Sanguine Pool 28s. Riposte's 24s at rank 1 is the longest window in the lane and the one you actually poke into.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into phases[3], phases[4], phases[5], whys[5], spikes[1] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Duelist's Dance healing was never named as the anti-heal trigger, and Lunge applying on-hit effects was never mentioned at all.
audit.why: Both Duelist's Dance and a completed Grand Challenge heal her, so Grievous Wounds has to be on her before the fourth vital rather than after. Lunge applies on-hit effects, which is why her damage tracks her items and why reading the trade off raw resistances gets it wrong.
audit.corrected: Vital healing written into phases[0], phases[3] and spikes[1]; the on-hit interaction written into report[5].

edits.before: Q-drain on cooldown — you trade HP like a loan shark. Identify how Fiora contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Fiora takes level 1: every Duelist's Dance vital she hits heals her and speeds her up, so give ground and last-hit at range.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Riposte's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your window: Lunge is 13s at rank 1 and Riposte 24s, so poke inside those gaps. Anti-heal first — her vitals heal her.

edits.before: Hemoplague + empowered Q turns mid-game fights into resets. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Fiora's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Grand Challenge is 110s at rank 1 and heals her when all four vitals land. Deny vitals by moving, and never stand and duel.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Riposte's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker is your spike — force the fight the moment it lands, inside Riposte's 24s.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Fiora carry threat 10/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: Hemoplague's amp and Crimson Pact health beat her single-target duel — punish her the moment she walks in.

edits.before: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — Parries + stuns. Don’t poke into it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Riposte: 24s at rank 1 — it parries all damage and stuns if it blocked an immobilise, so never poke into the window. - Lunge: 13s at rank 1. - Grand Challenge: 110s. - Sanguine Pool: 28s. - Hemoplague: 120s.

edits.before: Track Fiora's Riposte: Parries + stuns. Don’t poke into it. When it is down — Q-E + R her.
edits.after: Lunge applies on-hit effects, so her damage tracks her items, not just her raw attack damage.

edits.before: Level 1 is even before her vital-and-Lunge trade pattern comes online.
edits.after: Fiora wins level 1 — Duelist's Dance vitals heal her off every proc.

edits.before: First item favours Fiora as her dueling and true damage spike hardest.
edits.after: First item favours you as Riftmaker sustain outlasts her 13s Lunge windows.

edits.before: Late is even and positional — pool and Hemoplague let you punish her in fights.
edits.after: Late is yours — pool and Hemoplague punish her the moment she walks into a group.

edits.before: Her Grand Challenge (R) sets up all four vitals and a huge heal on completion — a lvl-6 duel with her ult up can burst you and top her off. This is even for you: don't stand and duel, kite her Q cooldown and use pool to break her vital chase.
edits.after: Her Grand Challenge (R) is 110s at rank 1: it reveals all four vitals and heals her and nearby allies on completion. Don't stand and duel — kite Lunge's 13s cooldown, pool to break her vital chase, and have Grievous Wounds on her before the fourth vital.

notes: The packet suspectName 'Her Grand Challenge' is a FALSE POSITIVE — correct name. The Profane Hydra / Ravenous Hydra inconsistency the mirror flagged is not present in Vladimir's copy of this matchup; the item line here is Riftmaker plus Zhonya's throughout.
